files.description: Primary (b)(10) EHI export documentation. 7-page PDF containing: overview of EHI export mechanism, screenshots of the Data Portability/Export interface (single patient, group, and population export), list of 21 FHIR R4 resources exported in FHIR JSON format, resource description table with generic FHIR definitions, and support contact info. Notes that 'all other resources' are exported in 'standard JSON format' but does not document those resources.

EHI export landing page from Agastha's certification site. Contains version history table (v1.0, 2023-04-10), links to the B10 PDF, and a link to the FHIR API R4 documentation. Minimal content beyond linking to the PDF.

Supplementary FHIR R4 API documentation (primarily (g)(10) patient API docs). Includes OAuth/SMART authentication flow, Bulk Data export endpoints, and per-resource API details for the same 21 FHIR resources listed in the B10 PDF. Saved because the B10 export uses FHIR format and the dataExport page links to this as supplementary documentation.
